g.text: SD04 - Customer absent at delivery (AD12 / AD15 / AD27)
times, customers, addresses, contact persons and phone numbers
At the first visit, nobody answers the door.
Call customer after first unanswered visit
[Customer can still receive during first visit]

Leave a notice at the delivery address that a visit was attempted.
second attempt scheduled for the SAME day
